title: 第24章 枯柳密谈，巧掩身世
slug: 欠我时间债天道也得跪着还
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

枯柳坡的夜黑得像墨汁泼过。

苏余出镇后一路向北疾行，身后黑石镇的灯火在夜幕中缩成几点暗淡的萤火，最终被起伏的山脊彻底吞没。

他没有走大路——大路上到处都是各方势力布下的眼线，灵蛇商行的探子、烈阳宗的巡夜、散修联盟的暗哨，每一双眼睛都在盯着来往的人。

他走的是猎人才会选的兽道，在灌木丛和乱石滩之间穿行，脚下没有路，但每一步都踩在最不会留下痕迹的地方。

丑时三刻，他到达枯柳坡。

那棵被雷劈过的枯柳树像一具焦黑的骨架立在坡顶，枝丫扭曲着刺向夜空。

林霜坐在枯柳树下，听霜剑横在膝上，正用一块干净的布擦拭剑身。

她的动作很慢很细致，每一寸剑身都要来回擦三遍，像是在给一个老朋友擦拭身体。

看见苏余从夜色中走出来，她停下手中的动作，手指在剑柄上微微松了几分。

“还活着。”

语气平淡，但苏余听出了她声音里压着的那层紧绷——那是等了近两个时辰、每一息都在担心他回不来的紧绷。

“没有拿到核心情报，但捡了一条命。”

苏余在她对面盘膝坐下。

月光从枯柳的枝丫缝隙中漏下来，在他脸上投下斑驳的光影。

他从怀中取出几块干粮分给林霜，然后一边啃干粮一边将石楼中的发现说了一遍。

他说得很简略，但每个关键点都没有遗漏——天机阁背后另有一人，此人以铜镜为媒介藏身暗处，各方势力是被此人引来的，目的不是夺宝，是围猎。

把所有拿到秘境宝物的人当成猎物，把各方势力当成猎犬，而这个人自己则坐在镜子里看戏。

林霜听完沉默了很久。

风吹过枯柳枝丫发出呜呜的鸣响，像有人在很远的地方哭。

她的手指在听霜剑的剑鞘上轻轻敲了三下——那是她思考时的习惯动作。

“这个人知道你的底细吗？”

她问到了最关键的问题上。

“知道一些。”

苏余没有回避她的目光，“但他暂时不会把我的底细捅出去。

不是因为他好心，是因为他觉得游戏太早结束就没意思了。

他要看的是围猎——把我放在各方势力的追捕网里，看我能挣扎多久。

但如果有一天他觉得腻了，或者我逃得太远脱离了他的掌控，他随时可以把我的底细当成筹码卖给任何一方势力。”

“那他的筹码是什么？你的底细——到底是什么？”

苏余没有立刻回答。

他将归字剑从背上解下来放在膝上，手指抚过剑身上那条暗金色的血线，像是在抚摸一个老友的伤疤。

镜中人的警告在他脑海中一字一字地回放——不要把你在遗迹中得到的东西告诉任何人，包括那个拎着青云宗听霜剑的女人。

一旦她知道了你的真实底细，守宫蛊就会在她体内产生异变，咬穿她的心脉。

他不能说“时族”，不能说“时之种”，不能说“时间债务”。

但他也不想对林霜撒谎——至少，不想撒一个全无根据的谎。

“跟我来。”

他站起身，朝坡下走去。

枯柳坡下有一条干涸的小溪，溪床里铺满了被山洪冲下来的鹅卵石。

苏余在溪床中央站定，弯下腰捡起一块拳头大的鹅卵石放在左掌心，然后右手拔出归字剑。

The night at Kuliupo is as dark as ink splashed on it.

After Su Yu left the town, he rushed north. The lights of Blackstone Town behind him shrank into a few dim fireflies in the night, and were eventually completely swallowed up by the undulating ridges.

He did not take the main road - the main road was full of spies from various forces, including spies from the Spirit Snake Trading Company, night patrols from the Lieyang Sect, and secret sentries from the Loose Cultivator Alliance. Every pair of eyes was staring at the people coming and going.

He walked on the animal path that only hunters would choose, walking between bushes and rocky beaches. There was no road under his feet, but every step he took was in the place where it would least leave any traces.

At three o'clock in the ugly hour, he arrived at Kuliupo.

The dead willow tree that had been struck by lightning stood on the top of the slope like a blackened skeleton, its branches twisting and piercing into the night sky.

Lin Shuang was sitting under the withered willow tree, Tingshuang's sword lying across his knees, and he was wiping the sword body with a clean cloth.

Her movements were very slow and meticulous, and she had to wipe every inch of the sword back and forth three times, as if she was wiping the body of an old friend.

Seeing Su Yu walking out of the night, she stopped what she was doing and relaxed her fingers slightly on the hilt of the sword.

"Still alive."

The tone was calm, but Su Yu could hear the tension in her voice - the tension of waiting for nearly two hours and worrying that he wouldn't come back with every breath.

"I didn't get the core information, but I saved a life."

Su Yu sat cross-legged opposite her.

The moonlight leaked through the gaps in the branches of the withered willows, casting mottled light and shadow on his face.

He took out a few pieces of dry food from his arms and gave them to Lin Shuang. Then, while nibbling the dry food, he told what he had found in the stone building.

He said it very briefly, but he did not miss every key point - there is another person behind Tianji Pavilion. This person uses the bronze mirror as a medium to hide in the dark. All the forces are attracted by this person, and the purpose is not to seize the treasure, but to hunt.

Treating everyone who gets the secret treasure as prey, treating all forces as hunting dogs, while this person himself sits in the mirror and watches the show.

Lin Shuang was silent for a long time after listening.

The wind blows through the dead willow branches and makes a whining sound, like someone crying in a far away place.

Her fingers tapped lightly on the scabbard of Tingshuang Sword three times - that was her habitual movement when thinking.

"Does this person know your details?"

She asked the most important question.

"Know something."

Su Yu did not avoid her gaze, "But he won't reveal my true identity for the time being.

Not because he was kind, but because he felt the game would be boring if it ended too early.

What he wants to see is hunting - putting me in the hunting net of all forces to see how long I can struggle.

But if one day he gets tired of it, or if I escape too far and escape his control, he can use my details as a bargaining chip to sell to any force at any time."

"Then what's his bargaining chip? What's your background?"

Su Yu didn't answer immediately.

He took the Gui Zi sword off his back and placed it on his lap. His fingers stroked the dark golden blood line on the sword, as if stroking the scar of an old friend.

The warning of the man in the mirror replayed word by word in his mind - don't tell anyone what you got in the ruins, including the woman carrying the Qingyun Sect Tingshuang Sword.

Once she knows your true identity, the gecko Gu will cause changes in her body and bite through her heart.

He can't say "time clan", he can't say "time seed", he can't say "time debt".

But he didn't want to lie to Lin Shuang - at least, he didn't want to tell a completely baseless lie.

"Follow me."

He stood up and walked down the slope.

There is a dry stream under the dry willow slope, and the stream bed is filled with pebbles washed down by flash floods.

Su Yu stood still in the middle of the creek bed, bent down and picked up a fist-sized pebble and placed it in his left palm, then pulled out the Gui Zi sword with his right hand.
